content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty SEV2 page fired -> az16 (eu-west-az16) serving: sudden CPU + 5xx spike, autoscaler thrashing, potential graceful degen/evac in progress. page: PD#31782.

pagerduty-bot: PD#31782 triggered, urgency: high. escalation policy: region-sre->oncall-sre.

ops-oncall: acked. I'll start coordinating. @alice.nguyen can you grab top-level customer impact numbers?

alice.nguyen: on it. hitting dashboards now. quick note: requests->eu-west-az16 are up 3.6x in qps vs baseline, 5xx rate ~2.8% over last 2m, p95 latency 420ms. only az16 serving pool affected so far. customers on dedicated capacity may see elevated errors.

bob_k: adding logs from runtime: seeing repeated KILL from hypervisor on some workers around 2759876520. suspecting spot preemption on a subset causing cache thrash.

carol-sre: can we divert traffic off az16 to az14/az15? what's the rollback cost for active KV cache?

dave-eng: we have policy route-based fallback ready. proposing: gradual divert 30%->70% over 2m, enable stale-KV read fallback to avoid regen storms. downside: slightly older cache -> possible small quality regressions for prefix caching.

ops-oncall: sounds good. executing divert with canary now. console-bot: run command to update routing policy.

console-bot: executing: \n```\nredwood route update --region eu-west --from az16 --to az14,az15 --percent 30 --mode gradual --reason "PD#31782 - az16 capacity instability"\n```\n
ops-oncall: route update applied. monitoring metrics.

alice.nguyen: after divert start: az16 requests down 28%, az14+az15 absorbing traffic. 5xx rate on az16 still climbing a bit (2.9%) but global 5xx rate is stabilizing (0.6% down from 1.1%). note: ~12 customer sessions saw transient errors during cutover window.

carol-sre: nice. we should also attempt graceful eviction of bad hosts. ops-oncall, can you coordinate eviction + reattach of healthy hosts? use soft-evict then drain.

ops-oncall: initiating soft-evict on flagged instances (host ids: h-az16-7a3, h-az16-9b1). command: \n```\ninfra evict --hosts h-az16-7a3,h-az16-9b1 --mode soft --wait 60s\n```\n
incident-bot: auto-escalation check: 2m since page, no PD ack escalation. next escalation in 3m if not resolved.

bob_k: logs after eviction start: KV rehydrate attempts spiked, few cache misses causing retries but no systemic OOM. kernel logs show preemption window narrowed.

dave-eng: suggested: enable prefixcache rehydrate rate-limit to 100/s during regen to avoid upstream overload. config: \n```\nserving.config.prefixcache.rehydrate_rate=100\n```\n
ops-oncall: applying rate-limit now.

alice.nguyen: post-rate-limit: global 5xx dropping to 0.35%, p95 down to 180ms. az16 still has some worker churn but error budget trending down. customer-impact: ~0.7% of requests still observing errors for customers pinned to az16 dedicated pools. working on customer comms draft.

carol-sre: agree on comms. recommend ETE note and targeted DM for customers with >1% failures. cc @dave-eng for rollback plan if divert isn't enough.

dave-eng: rollback plan ready: revert route with two-step drain, or escalate to multi-region fallback if az16 continues to degrade.

ops-oncall: ops handoff — I'll stay on until stabilization, then hand to EU morning responder at +45m. will update PD with timeline and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: PD#31782 status updated: mitigations applied (routing divert, soft-evict, prefixcache rate-limit). awaiting stabilization.

alice.nguyen: final check at +5m: 5xx global at 0.2%, az16 p95 160ms, no new preemptions for 4m. recommending close after 15m stable.

pagerduty-bot: PD#31782: acknowledged by ops-oncall, annotated with mitigation steps. close suggestion in 15m if no regressions. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: adding postmortem stub and timeline. will capture root cause hypotheses (spot preemptions -> autoscaler thrash -> KV regen storm -> transient 5xxs). follow-up: model capacity tagging, improve preemption detection alarm thresholds.

carol-sre: thanks team. I'll take the action items for postmortem and customer comms. handing off to oncall rotation: @ops-oncall -> @alice_nguyen at 2759877400 for monitoring window.
